The target metric is defined by its position relative to a pre-registered interval. The relationship between the calculated monthly change and these boundaries is the direct determinant of the final option.

Given the lack of specific forecast-time evidence, the reasoning must rely on the structural relationships identified in the DAG, acknowledging that the actual values of the CPI observations and the resulting change are unknown.
